remarks:
Welcome home to 416 Woodward Crescent with a brand-new Front Entry
Door & Side Windows creating an inviting entrance.  This pristine 4
Bedroom, 2.5 Bath Colonial offering 2135 sq ft includes a stunning
Sunroom with ceiling fan for added living space. Step outside and
enjoy the meticulously maintained grounds, featuring beautiful
landscaping, a stamped-concrete patio and walkway that add charm,
character and curb appeal, There is a Gazebo and Shed built by the
Amish .  Walk in from the Sunroom into the comfortable Family Room
with Gas Fireplace w/remote & Crown Molding.  The Kitchen has hardwood
floors, oak cupboards and features a walk in Pantry 7' x 5' which
could be turned into a 1st Floor Laundry.  Spacious Living Room also
has Crown Molding.  Nice size Dining Room could also be an Office.
There is a half bathroom on the 1st floor. Walk up the wood staircase
to 4 large bedrooms, the Primary has double closets and en-suite
bathroom. There is also an additional full bathroom upstairs. This
home has Central A/C and a Central Vacuum System, a 2 Car Garage and
Double Wide driveway.  Good size Basement with Work Bench, Glass Block
Windows, Sump Pump with Water Back Up. Full Tear off Roof 2021.
Appliances are included, except Refrigerator is Negotiable, Washer and
Dryer also included. West Seneca Schools. Tax records do not include the addl' 167 sq feet for Sunroom 
Measured and verified by agent.
Open House – Sat, 10/3 1-3:00
